title: Smart Stick Alert for Grandpa's Evening Walks
title_te: తాతయ్య సాయంత్రం నడకకు స్మార్ట్ కర్ర హెచ్చరిక
problem: Grandpa walks with a wooden stick on our bumpy village lane, but he often trips over sleeping stray dogs or deep potholes in the dark.
idea: A phone on grandpa's stick or pocket watches the path. When it sees a dog, pothole or stone, it plays a loud beep and warning. Here you can tap what the camera 'sees'.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What is on grandpa's path?
widgets.intro: In my real project, PictoBlox object detection looks at the lane through the camera. Here, tap what it sees.
widgets.question: The camera sees this in front of grandpa:

options.label: Sleeping dog
options.result: Beep beep! Dog ahead. Walk slowly to the side.
options.te: బీప్! ముందు కుక్క ఉంది. మెల్లగా పక్కకి నడవండి.

options.label: Pothole
options.result: Beep beep! Hole in the road. Stop and step around.
options.te: బీప్! రోడ్డులో గుంత ఉంది. ఆగి పక్కనుంచి వెళ్ళండి.

options.label: Big stone
options.result: Careful! Stone ahead. Lift your feet.

widgets.heading: ✅ Grandpa's Safe Evening Walk Check
widgets.intro: Tick what grandpa has before going out.

items.text: Torch or phone light is on
Light-coloured shirt so vehicles can see him
Family phone number in his pocket
Walks on a known path, before it gets very dark
items.te: బాగా చీకటి పడక ముందే తెలిసిన దారిలో నడక

bands.text: Super! Grandpa is ready for a safe walk.
Almost there. Add the missing things.
Please get these things ready before he goes out.

how: Take photos on our lane in the evening: potholes, stones, sleeping dogs and clear path (about 40 each).
Train an Image Project in Teachable Machine with these 4 classes and export the model.
In PictoBlox, add the Machine Learning extension and load the model.
Add blocks: if class is Dog or Pothole, play a loud beep sound and say the warning.
Ask Gemini to write short Telugu warning words for each obstacle.
Test it slowly with grandpa, with a family member walking next to him.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student making a walking helper for my grandfather. Write very short warning messages (5 words or less) in Telugu and English for: dog ahead, pothole ahead, stone ahead, path is clear.
